yes can be done in a separate task, problem is that scroll to bottom requires a few hooks, and ui components can't currently use hooks (as react and preact have different imports). Did you try a fork of use-scroll-to-bottom that has preact hooks instead?

I reimplemented the basics of it, a ResizeObserver and a listener on the container scroll. The lock kept jumping (which might be because rendering of the carousel is problematic I think). We can try having a Preact-compatible fork, it might handle this better.
should this not be Hit or AlgoliaHit? or do you want to explicitly make it available for recommend / item without __position too?
